name: verifyInsuranceEligibility
shortDescription: Calls an external insurance platform to verify patient eligibility or submit claims, returning the verification status.
description:
Overview

Interacts with an external insurance platform to verify a patient's eligibility for services or to submit claims. This function provides real-time checks and can be used during appointment booking or administrative processes.

Intended use

Called by the UI (e.g., during appointment scheduling or patient registration) to check insurance eligibility.

Logic

  1. Validate input parameters, including patientProfileId and optionally appointmentId.
  2. Retrieve PatientProfile data (e.g., insurance details) using ctx.data.get.
  3. Call the external InsurancePlatform API (e.g., ctx.service('InsurancePlatform').check_eligibility(patient_data)) to perform the verification.
  4. Process the response from the insurance platform.
  5. Audit-log the eligibility check using ctx.audit.log.
  6. Return the eligibility status and any relevant details.

Entities

  • PatientProfile
  • Appointment

External Services

  • InsurancePlatform
